say:1:1421441001:1.text: Fortunately, it's just a few soldiers taking liberties where they shouldn't. Acting on a whim.
say:1:1421441001:1.source_cn: 还好，只是几个士兵临时起意的拦路抢劫。

choice_prompt:2:1421441001.text: Fortunately, it's just a few soldiers taking liberties where they shouldn't. Acting on a whim.
choice_prompt:2:1421441001.source_cn: 还好，只是几个士兵临时起意的拦路抢劫。

say:3:1421441002:1.text: Yes. Compared to what we've seen recently, this is nothing. There've been organized raids on households—much more brutal, far more destructive.
say:3:1421441002:1.source_cn: 是。前些天经常会有直接冲击住宅的抢劫，通常行为更残忍，...
say:3:1421441002:1.male: Yes. Compared to what we've seen recently, this is nothing. There've been organized raids on households—much more brutal, far more destructive.
say:3:1421441002:1.female: Yes. Compared to what we've seen recently, this is nothing. There've been organized raids on households—much more brutal, far more destructive.

say:4:1421441004:1.text: A lot of it's commoners... but we've had problems with undisciplined new guards, too.
say:4:1421441004:1.source_cn: 行凶的通常是平民……但像这样作乱的新卫队也不在少数。
say:4:1421441004:1.male: A lot of it's commoners... but we've had problems with undisciplined new guards, too.
say:4:1421441004:1.female: A lot of it's commoners... but we've had problems with undisciplined new guards, too.

say:5:1421441005:1.text: The nobles are still the main targets. Their estates are understaffed, their defenses stretched thin.
say:5:1421441005:1.source_cn: 受害的大部分是贵族。如今，许多贵族家里余下的安保人员不...
say:5:1421441005:1.male: The nobles are still the main targets. Their estates are understaffed, their defenses stretched thin.
say:5:1421441005:1.female: The nobles are still the main targets. Their estates are understaffed, their defenses stretched thin.

say:6:1421441006:1.text: But commoners suffer just as much, especially when these gangs go after weaker neighborhoods.
say:6:1421441006:1.source_cn: 但也有些平民，因为本身缺乏防御力，在犯罪者集中起来的时...
say:6:1421441006:1.male: But commoners suffer just as much, especially when these gangs go after weaker neighborhoods.
say:6:1421441006:1.female: But commoners suffer just as much, especially when these gangs go after weaker neighborhoods.

say:8:1421441007:1.text: And I'd wager half of the smaller incidents aren't even reported.
say:8:1421441007:1.source_cn: 嗯，估计还有不少人，如果受害不严重，都不会向你们报告才对。

say:9:1421441008:1.text: Exactly. Before, nobles would raise a storm over the slightest scratch on their property.
say:9:1421441008:1.source_cn: 正是。以前我带队的时候，那些贵族连门口的雕饰裂开了一条...

say:10:1421441009:1.text: Now? One of their manors nearly burned to the ground before we intervened.
say:10:1421441009:1.source_cn: 但前段时间，如果不是我们听到响动到的及时，他们家都要被...

say:11:1421441010:1.text: Old habits die hard, I suppose. My mother did enjoy her little... tests.
say:11:1421441010:1.source_cn: 毕竟他们还放不下心嘛，毕竟过去我母亲的作风可是反复无常...

say:12:1421441011:1.text: This kind of quiet compliance, this illusion of order—it's only natural.
say:12:1421441011:1.source_cn: 像这样战战兢兢地用沉默和温顺表示服从，也算是一种常见的心态。

say:13:1421441012:1.text: And now, with the new guards throwing their weight around, I imagine the nobility doesn't know who to trust anymore.
say:13:1421441012:1.source_cn: 更何况，现在还有这些耀武扬威的新卫队存在，对旧贵族来说...

say:14:1421441013:1.text: ...I haven't done enough. The guard needs stricter oversight.
say:14:1421441013:1.source_cn: 是我对卫队的甄选和控制还不够……

choice_prompt:15:1421441013.text: ...I haven't done enough. The guard needs stricter oversight.
choice_prompt:15:1421441013.source_cn: 是我对卫队的甄选和控制还不够……

say:16:1421441014:1.text: That's all I can do for now. If we still had the priests to serve as our voice, we could calm the people with a few carefully chosen words.
say:16:1421441014:1.source_cn: 嗯，一时间也没别的办法，要是还有祭司来充当喉舌，多宣传...
say:16:1421441014:1.male: That's all I can do for now. If we still had the priests to serve as our voice, we could calm the people with a few carefully chosen words.
say:16:1421441014:1.female: That's all I can do for now. If we still had the priests to serve as our voice, we could calm the people with a few carefully chosen words.

say:17:1421441015:1.text: But most of that's gone now. And our forces are stretched to the brink.
say:17:1421441015:1.source_cn: 但现在也都处理得差不多了……而且卫队人手也很紧张吧？

say:18:1421441016:1.text: Right. We've already purged the worst offenders, and now we're juggling patrols, treatments, and managing detainees.
say:18:1421441016:1.source_cn: 是。本来就筛选掉了一批人，如今需要把守的地方太多，还有...

say:19:1421441017:1.text: And even with all that, things still slip through the cracks.
say:19:1421441017:1.source_cn: 即使是现在这点人，也会出现刚刚那种情况。

say:20:1421441018:1.text: Hmm. These temporary recruits are unreliable. What about forming smaller patrol teams?
say:20:1421441018:1.source_cn: 现在说民兵或者征召临时队员也不靠谱，这样，用小组巡逻吧？

say:21:1421441019:1.text: Pairs or trios, like scouts, each with a signal device.
say:21:1421441019:1.source_cn: 1-3人左右的小组，带上信号设备，遇到情况第一时间通报...

say:22:1421441020:1.text: Keep two teams in every district, rotating shifts. At the very least, it buys us time.
say:22:1421441020:1.source_cn: 正常的队伍每个街区保留两组左右，这样轮换和集合，至少能...

say:23:1421441021:1.text: Understood. I'll see to it right—...ah. Apologies.
say:23:1421441021:1.source_cn: 是，我知道了，我这就去——呃，抱歉。

say:25:1421441022:1.text: Haha! Still getting used to being in charge, Indris?
say:25:1421441022:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈，还没习惯自己的身份吗，因度厄？

say:26:1421441023:1.text: I'm merely your meddlesome advisor now. You hold the reins.
say:26:1421441023:1.source_cn: 现在我只是个提供建言的佞臣，你才是那个做出决策的领导者啊。

say:29:1421441003:1.text: Yes. Most attacks these days are calculated. Roles assigned, plans made. Tracking these groups has been... difficult.
say:29:1421441003:1.source_cn: 嗯，前些天经常会出现一群人组织好行动的情况，有计划有分...
say:29:1421441003:1.male: Yes. Most attacks these days are calculated. Roles assigned, plans made. Tracking these groups has been... difficult.
say:29:1421441003:1.female: Yes. Most attacks these days are calculated. Roles assigned, plans made. Tracking these groups has been... difficult.
